import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from src.ClassifierPipeline import ClassifierPipeline
from src.constants.constants import FEATURE_COLS

# Load data (abbreviated)
labeled_utterances_df = pd.read_csv(''utterances_sample_labeled.csv'')
utterances_df = pd.read_csv(''utterances_sample.csv'')
nontoken_feature_cols = [c for c in utterances_df.columns if c not in labeled_utterances_df.columns]
labeled_utterances_df[nontoken_feature_cols] = utterances_df[nontoken_feature_cols]

labeled_utterances_df[''text''] = labeled_utterances_df[''text''].fillna('''')
labeled_utterances_df[''speaker.position''] = labeled_utterances_df[''speaker.position''].fillna(''OTHER'')
for col in [''section_cues'', ''speech_act_cues'']:
    labeled_utterances_df[col] = labeled_utterances_df[col].fillna(''OTHER'')
for col in [''relative_position'', ''sent_count'', ''token_count'', ''mentions_speaker'', ''mentions_bill'']:
    labeled_utterances_df[col] = labeled_utterances_df[col].fillna(0)

labeled_utterances_df[''hearing_group''] = labeled_utterances_df[''bid''].astype(str) + ''_'' + labeled_utterances_df[''hid''].astype(str)

# Split
splitter = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.25, random_state=69)
train_idx, test_idx = next(splitter.split(
    labeled_utterances_df, 
    labeled_utterances_df[''section''], 
    groups=labeled_utterances_df[''hearing_group'']
))

train_df = labeled_utterances_df.iloc[train_idx].copy()
train_df = train_df.sort_values(by=[''hearing_group'', ''uid'']).reset_index(drop=True)

X_train = train_df[FEATURE_COLS + [''uid'', ''hearing_group'']]
y_train = train_df[''section'']

# Create parser
parser = ClassifierPipeline(
    base_estimator=LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000, class_weight=''balanced''),
    masking=False,
    smoothing=False
)

print(f''Parser masking setting: {parser.masking}'')
print(f''Parser smoothing setting: {parser.smoothing}'')
print()

# Fit
parser.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Check if masker is getting class_mask set
print(''Checking masker state...'')
masker = parser.model.named_steps[''masker'']
print(f''Masker class_mask: {masker.class_mask}'')
print()

# Test prediction on a small sample
test_sample = X_train[:5]
print(''Test sample hearing_groups:'', test_sample[''hearing_group''].tolist())

# Manually call _predict_sections to see what happens
first_hearing_group = test_sample[''hearing_group''].iloc[0]
first_hearing_data = test_sample[test_sample[''hearing_group''] == first_hearing_group][FEATURE_COLS]

print(f''\nCalling _predict_sections for {first_hearing_group}...'')
print(f''Masking enabled: {parser.masking}'')

predictions = parser._predict_sections(first_hearing_data)
print(f''Predictions: {predictions}'')
print(f''True labels: {list(y_train[test_sample[""hearing_group""] == first_hearing_group])}'')
")
